caption: The drawing depicts a landscape scene colored in shades of brown, ochre, and muted green. In the foreground, there is a set of three rail vehicles on tracks: a cattle car labeled "CATTLE" with slatted sides, a passenger car with a striped roof and curtains, and a small open wagon being pushed by a person holding an umbrella. Behind and above this rail line, there are rolling hills colored in layers of brown and green, with several trees scattered across the landscape displaying green and brown foliage. Two buildings are present on the hills: a small white house with a slanted roof and a larger structure resembling a domed tower or observatory. The sky above is filled with a warm, ochre wash. The scene is contained within a roughly oval boundary, beyond which the paper is left uncolored except for a scale bar in the bottom right corner.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
